question: What does a frontier lab sell: a commodity, or a premium?
headline: What does a frontier lab sell: a commodity, or a premium?

parts.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic Are Not the Same Business
parts.question: What does a frontier lab sell: a commodity, or a premium?

call.line: Stop pricing OpenAI and Anthropic as one bet. One revenue line holds under pressure; the other has to be bought.
actions: Separate the two in any AI exposure: pricing power, not headline growth, sets the value.
Demand life-of-cluster margins in any prospectus, not first-year GPU economics.
Treat customer concentration and investor-funded revenue as the first red flags.
flips: Anthropic is forced into an OpenAI-style price cut on coding.
Audited losses or a DeepSeek-style price reversal erase the gap between the two businesses.

history.line: Stop pricing OpenAI and Anthropic as one bet. One revenue line holds under pressure; the other has to be bought.

notes.label: The number three bears collided with
notes.text: SemiAnalysis: on a current cluster the labs can earn over $100B per gigawatt-year against about $12B of rental cost. Daniel Romero: a GPU earns most of its cash in year one while the books depreciate it straight. Steve Eisman: there is no dataset here like the subprime delinquency data; he waits for the two labs to open their books.

tests.event: An audited listing reveals margins, customer concentration and investor-linked revenue; clean disclosure would support separation, weak economics would reunite the risks.
Useful-life assumptions show whether first-year GPU margins survive across the cluster; Romero’s accounting would gain force if they do not.
A quiet reversal would weaken Erkan’s demand evidence; sustained higher prices would support the view that demand remains structurally strong.
Return on invested capital should be visible by Romero’s deadline; failure would turn today’s extraordinary economics into a first-year illusion.
Another model suspension would turn Massif’s signal into procurement policy, showing that open weights are changing buying behavior.
